name: The Man Outside the Elevator
source:
Kei is running late for work when the elevator he's in suddenly stops. The doors open to a place different from the one he entered.

[From [url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/the-man-outside-the-elevator]itch.io[/url]]
